mapper.select: select id, playbook_id, step_key, skill_id, step_type, parallel_group, depends_on, track_key, sort_order, enabled from crm_ai_skill_playbook_step where playbook_id = #{playbookId} order by sort_order asc, id asc

select s.id, s.playbook_id, s.step_key, s.skill_id, s.step_type, s.parallel_group, s.depends_on, s.track_key, s.sort_order, s.enabled, sk.name as skill_name from crm_ai_skill_playbook_step s left join crm_ai_skill sk on sk.id = s.skill_id where s.playbook_id = #{playbookId} order by s.sort_order asc, s.id asc

mapper.select: select s.id from crm_ai_skill_playbook_step s inner join crm_ai_skill_playbook p on p.id = s.playbook_id where s.skill_id = #{skillId} and p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} limit 1
select count(*) from crm_ai_skill_playbook_step where playbook_id = #{playbookId}
